mechanism: Both drugs undergo renal elimination and valacyclovir metabolite (acyclovir) may compete for renal tubular secretion; meprobamate CNS depression may be additive with valacyclovir's potential neurotoxic effects at high doses.
action: Monitor renal function and neurological status; ensure adequate hydration; use meprobamate cautiously in patients with renal impairment receiving valacyclovir.
